name: 1880-longdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90) of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:1.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine, one GPU, one node.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, vocab 128256, rope_theta 500000, 8192 window, bf16, 8.03e9 parameters.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 640 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion, static seed 1880.
workload: `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 4096 tokens and output EXACTLY 512 (min = max on both), so the run is a fixed amount of work. Greedy (temperature 0.0) and EOS is ignored, so every request emits all 512 tokens.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant drafting long replies from book-length prompts for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# A single-GPU serve of an 8B grouped-query chat model at long context.
# This is v0.4.2-era AsyncEngineArgs: a key it does not know is a TypeError at engine
# construction, so do not add arguments from a later vLLM.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256
dtype: bfloat16
block-size: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
enable-chunked-prefill: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
